verses.text: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some people will turn away from the faith. They will listen to spirits that lead people astray, and to things taught by demons.
These teachings come through liars who pretend to be good. Their consciences have been burnt dead, as if with a hot iron.
They forbid people to marry. They order them not to eat certain foods. But God made these foods to be eaten with thanks by those who believe and know the truth.
Everything God made is good. Nothing should be refused if it is received with thanks,
because it is made holy by God's word and by prayer.
If you teach these things to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will be fed by the words of the faith and the good teaching you have followed.
Have nothing to do with ungodly myths and old wives' tales. Instead, train yourself to live for God.
Training the body has some value, but living for God has value in every way. It holds a promise for the life we live now and for the life to come.
This is a saying you can trust, which everyone should accept.
That is why we work hard and put up with insults. We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Saviour of all people, and most of all of those who believe.
Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young. Instead, be an example to the believers in what you say, in how you live, in love, in spirit, in faith and in purity.
Until I come, give your attention to reading the Scriptures aloud, to encouraging people, and to teaching.
Do not neglect the gift God gave you. It was given to you through a prophecy, when the church leaders laid their hands on you.
Work hard at these things. Give yourself fully to them, so that everyone can see how you are growing.
Watch your life and your teaching closely. Keep on doing these things. If you do, you will save both yourself and those who listen to you.
